import Partition
namespace Universal233.CherryBranching
open RMAF CoreGraph Integration VertexGeometry CutRealization HardParent

/-- Enumerate each original cherry once, including its original parent address.
The leaf order is the actual child order; no sorting/root sentinel is inserted. -/
def cherries : Tree → List (RMAF.Vertex × Nat × Nat)
 | .leaf _ => []
 | .node (.leaf a) (.leaf b) => [([],a,b)]
 | .node l r =>
   (cherries l).map (fun (p,a,b) => (false::p,a,b)) ++
   (cherries r).map (fun (p,a,b) => (true::p,a,b))

structure Candidate where
 parent : RMAF.Vertex
 a : Nat
 b : Nat
 originalCuts : List RMAF.Vertex
 deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def candidates (T S : Tree) : List Candidate :=
 (cherries T).map fun (p,a,b) => ⟨p,a,b,cuts S a b⟩

import Safety
namespace Universal233.CherryBranching
open RMAF CoreGraph Integration VertexGeometry CutRealization HardParent

/-- Original child edges, in original vertex traversal order. No upward edge. -/
def cuts (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) := pendantOriginal S a b

def coreLabels (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) : List Nat :=
 (leaves S).filter fun x => !((cuts S a b).map (subtreeLabels S)).flatten.contains x

def pendantPartition (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) : List (List Nat) :=
 (cuts S a b).map (subtreeLabels S) ++ [coreLabels S a b]

def componentRoots (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) : List RMAF.Vertex := cuts S a b ++ [[]]

import RMAF

/-! One-shot executable original-source controls. The vertices are unsuppressed
addresses; a cut records the child of its ORIGINAL directed edge. -/
namespace Universal233.HardParent
open RMAF

def vertices : Tree → List Vertex
  | .leaf _ => [[]]
  | .node l r => [] :: (prependSide false (vertices l) ++ prependSide true (vertices r))

def pendantOriginal (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) : List Vertex :=
  (vertices S).filter fun v => !v.isEmpty &&
    (minimalVertices [a,b] S).contains v.dropLast &&
    !(minimalVertices [a,b] S).contains v

def subtreeLabels : Tree → Vertex → List Nat
  | S, [] => leaves S
  | .leaf _, _ :: _ => []
  | .node l r, s :: v => subtreeLabels (if s then r else l) v

import GroupPriority

/-! One-shot literal ordinary-restriction materializer for current source output.
Missing restrictions are filtered operationally; checked nonempty Q proves that
none is missing. No default tree or assumed graph/cost field is used. -/
namespace OutputState
open RMAF RestrictionBridge ForestState

def sourceForest (S : Tree) (Q : List (List Nat)) : List Tree :=
  Q.filterMap (fun U => restrict U S)

meaning: False/true addresses select original left/right child edges. vertices is original preorder; pendantOriginal filters nonroot child addresses whose parent lies in the literal a,b minimal vertex hull and whose child does not. pendantPartition enumerates those entire original subtrees followed by the leaf complement. sourceForest filterMaps ordinary unary-suppressed restrict for each literal partition block. These are definitions, not acceptance of validity/coverage/cost/algorithm claims.
